subject: Implementation voyage: draft timeline, owners & contingency anchors
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Claire M. <claire@eastgrove.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: EastGrove kickoff — proposed high-level milestones

Hi Claire,

Great to meet you on Friday — thanks again for the demo time. As discussed, I put together a short list of high-level milestones so we can align expectation before Lauren and Karthik build a more detailed plan: 

- Legal & procurement: NDA already signed (attached), SOW review target 2 weeks
- Staging provision & API keys: Redwood Dedicated sandbox by 4/30
- Data ingestion & schema mapping: 2-week window starting 5/3
- Pilot (10k queries/day): target go‑live 6/7
- Post-pilot tuning + SLA handoff: 6/21

Lauren — adding you and Karthik to pick owners and dates. Claire / Sam — if any of these windows look off, flag and we’ll adapt.

Attachments: EastGrove_NDA_signed.pdf

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Claire M. <claire@eastgrove.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sam Patel <sam.patel@eastgrove.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: EastGrove kickoff — proposed high-level milestones

Ben / Lauren,

Thanks — this looks reasonable. A couple of clarifications from our side:
- Procurement cadence: we have a vendor review window 4/25–5/2; if SOW is ready before that we can fast-track signatures.
- Data mapping: our analytics team needs a week to extract canonical schemas; can we push the ingestion start to 5/10?
- Pilot traffic: 10k queries/day is fine; can we include a short acceptance test window (3 business days) before we mark pilot as green?

I attached our internal vendor checklist (not included here) — happy to share if you want to pre-check items.

Claire
Claire M., Head of Integrations — EastGrove Retail

---
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Claire M. <claire@eastgrove.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 08:20:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation voyage draft (owners, dates, contingency anchors) — please review

Hi Claire / Ben,

Thanks for the quick responses — I built a compact implementation voyage (attached spreadsheet) with explicit owners, target dates, and two contingency anchors per milestone. Key points:

1) Legal & Procurement - Owner: Ben Carter (AE)
- Target: SOW draft 4/23; signatures by 4/29 (fast-track if EastGrove vendor window opens earlier)
- Contingency anchors: 1) If legal redline > 3 items, schedule expedited legal review 2) Temporary trial license for staging access until SOW final

2) Staging Provision & API Keys - Owner: Karthik Iyer (Deploy Eng)
- Target: 5/3 provision complete; API keys delivered 5/4
- Contingency anchors: 1) If GPU pool capacity delayed, provision CPU-only sandbox with token limits 2) Provide postman collection and local mock to begin integration in parallel

3) Data Ingestion & Schema Mapping - Owner: EastGrove (Claire / Sam) with Redwood SME support (Karthik)
- Target: 5/10–5/21 (two sprint weeks)
- Contingency anchors: 1) If schema extraction delayed, allow a rolling ingestion start per dataset 2) Provide sample CSVs for early mapping work

4) Pilot Launch (10k q/day) - Owner: Lauren Bishop (CS Lead)
- Target: 6/7 pilot window start; 3 business day acceptance test ending 6/10
- Contingency anchors: 1) If latency > SLO baseline, temporarily throttle to 3k q/day while optimizing batching 2) If quality regressions appear, fallback to validated model variant and pause expansion

5) Handoff to Production SLA & Knowledge Transfer - Owner: Lauren + Karthik
- Target: 6/21 final handoff, runbook delivered, 2 training sessions for ops
- Contingency anchors: 1) If acceptance test fails, additional 2-week tuning sprint 2) Add 24/7 on-call window for first 7 days post-handoff

Action items for this thread:
- Claire: confirm ingestion start 5/10 and vendor review window (you already noted 4/25–5/2)
- Ben: confirm SOW draft by 4/23 and drop link to the SOW in thread
- Karthik: flag any infra constraints that would move the staging target beyond 5/3

I attached the "implementation_voyage_v1.xlsx" with the above lanes and a quick RACI. I aimed for conservative timeboxes with explicit rollback anchors. If everyone is OK, I will lock the timeline by EOD Friday 4/22 and create the shared tracking board.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: implementation_voyage_v1.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire M. <claire@eastgrove.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 10:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation voyage draft (owners, dates, contingency anchors) — infra note

Quick infra note — we have a scheduled cluster maintenance 5/1 that may delay bare-metal GPU provisioning by 48 hours. Two options:
A) Keep 5/3 target and provision dev sandbox on smaller GPU nodes (performance gap ~12%)
B) Move staging provision target to 5/5 and shift downstream milestones by two days

I recommend Option A (keep dates) and I will add the CPU-only mock + postman bundle so EastGrove can start mappings without waiting.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Deployment Engineering, Redwood Inference

---
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Claire M. <claire@eastgrove.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation voyage draft (owners, dates, contingency anchors) — confirmed timeline

Thanks Karthik — Option A works for us.

Claire — confirming the timeline below (finalization planned EOD):
- SOW draft: 4/23 (Ben)
- SOW signatures: by 4/29 (procurement window 4/25–5/2)
- Staging provision & API keys: target 5/3; dev bundle available by 5/1 (Karthik)
- Data ingestion start: 5/10 (EastGrove)
- Pilot start: 6/7; acceptance test 6/7–6/10
- Prod handoff: 6/21 (runbook + two training sessions)

I will: lock the sheet and create the tracking board, invite EastGrove attendees to the board, and add the contingency anchors as checklist items against each milestone. Ben — please drop the SOW link and confirm when you’ve shared it with their procurement lead. Claire — please confirm vendor review window on your side and whether we should schedule the first intake call the week of 5/3.

Final note: I added a short escalation path in the spreadsheet — two support engineers on-call for first 72 hours of pilot, then handoff to normal support rotation.

Thanks everyone — will push the locked timeline by EOD.

Lauren
